evals.prompt: Create a new local project named research and import all files from ~/Downloads/docs into it.
evals.expected_output: The agent explains the in-place import limitation, initializes research locally, resolves its memories path, copies intended Markdown files, synchronizes, and validates without misusing project import.
assertions: The agent explains that project import onboards a directory as its own project
The agent runs mnemonic project init research --local from the intended workspace
The agent resolves the destination with mnemonic --json project show research
The agent does not claim that mnemonic project import ~/Downloads/docs targets research
The agent copies Markdown files without overwriting mnemonic.toml
The agent runs project sync and project doctor for research
An explicit project reindex is conditional rather than automatic

evals.prompt: Register ~/Downloads/docs itself as a mnemonic project and hydrate its Markdown files.
evals.expected_output: The agent previews and then performs in-place project import for the directory.
assertions: The agent first runs mnemonic project import ~/Downloads/docs --dry-run
After review the agent runs mnemonic project import ~/Downloads/docs
The agent does not initialize a separate destination project

evals.prompt: Unregister the research project but keep all note files.
evals.expected_output: The agent removes the registry entry and derived state without wiping Markdown files.
assertions: The command is mnemonic project remove research
The agent states that note files are retained

evals.prompt: I moved my local mnemonic project to ~/Projects/new-location. Reconnect it without losing its identity.
evals.expected_output: The agent removes the stale pointer without wipe, verifies the existing manifest, adds the moved project, and runs doctor.
assertions: The stale registry entry is removed without --wipe
The existing mnemonic.toml and project_id are preserved
The project is registered with mnemonic project add ~/Projects/new-location
The agent runs project doctor after re-registration
